verdict.rationale: The probe log notes that www.uscis.gov's Crawl-delay 10 was honored, which implies the main site serves a readable robots.txt that agents can consult before fetching. However, the public case-status host egov.uscis.gov returns HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare challenge at robots.txt itself, so an agent cannot learn that host's rules before being blocked. Missing for 10: a directly fetched and documented www.uscis.gov robots.txt rather than an indirect mention, a readable robots.txt on egov.uscis.gov, and consistent robots policy across all USCIS hosts.
